## A delay is the time between two events in one case

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- Infection to symptom onset is the incubation period. Onset to
  hospitalisation and onset to death sit on the same line
- We want the whole distribution over days, not a mean
- Nowcasts, forecasts and transmission models take one as an input and
  do not re-estimate it
